What We Expect to See in Ourselves and Our Colleagues

Top-Notch Mentality

We aim for excellence in everything we do. Top-notch isn’t just about outcomes, it’s also a mindset rooted in high standards, trust, ownership, and execution.

Success is Collective

We build on each other’s strengths. Individual achievements are based on team collaboration, peer feedback, and cross-functional support.

Follow Through

We honor every commitment and see it through, so our teammates and customers know they can trust us to deliver, every time.

Flexible Work Environment

We support work-life balance through flexible workplace arrangements that fit your life.

Know Why

Curiosity means pushing past what’s handed to us and figuring things out for ourselves. We believe understanding is earned through doing, not just knowing.

Resilience

We rise above tension that disrupts our work and distracts us from our goals. We own our mistakes, and embrace change and adapt as needed.
